status_detail: Production audit completed. The repository contains 35 new source-confirmed SHA-256 file indicators from current MalwareBazaar records dated 2026-09-29. Each accepted record supplied an exact SHA-256, named malware-family signature, timestamp, and malware tags. Daily-Threat-Intel supplied five IPv4 indicators and was correctly excluded. Bare export hashes, records without a named family, non-file indicators, PUP/adware, miners, and dual-use tools were rejected. Independent exact-hash corroboration was not established for this MalwareBazaar batch and is reported separately rather than overstated.
